title: Band leaders handing over; age and Eubie Blake
summary: Age limits playing, unlike Eubie Blake.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Look at (inaudible). You know where he is right now?
He's with his band, he's doing a college gig in Illinois.
He is? Yeah, but you know what he played?
I don't think he's playing piano anymore. I think he's just --
Well, certainly. He was a band leader years ago.

There you are. Just like this guy Lawrence Welk. He has an assistant leader. He starts them off and then gets over to the side. He announces what's coming on and all like that. And he lets this other guy take over.
It's just as reasonable as -- Mother Nature takes
-- steps in there after you're past 75. You can do what you did at 25.
So -- although there are exceptions to the rule, just like Eubie Blake. He's in his '90s now. For awhile, he didn't do anything. But how many men are there like him?
No. Maybe he hasn't been sick like I am. He certainly hasn't got arthritis like I have.
